title: Cost-Aware Agentic Feature Optimization System for Fleet-Scale Ranking Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.26531v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Large Web platforms operate large fleets of ranking models, each selecting features from a shared pool of tens of thousands. We present an end-to-end agentic system that optimizes features across the fleet under resource constraints shared across models and those set per model, such as feature pipeline cost and serving throughput (QPS), respectively. In this system, LLM agents propose hypotheses, and deterministic tools execute experiments and verify them. For each model, an LLM generates and shortlists cross features from a combinatorial candidate space, and all features are then ranked by several importance methods. Feature blending mixes these rankings into a single selection, using Pareto fronts across tasks for multi-task models. An LLM Researcher agent then tunes the feature selection in 10--25 asynchronous trials under resource caps, and a trimming step keeps the pipeline cost within budget. translated_title: 面向集群规模排序模型的成本感知智能体特征优化系统
translated_abstract: 大型网络平台运行着大规模的排序模型集群，每个模型都从包含数万个特征的共享特征池中选取特征。我们提出了一种端到端的智能体系统，在跨模型共享的资源约束和逐模型设定的资源约束（分别为特征管线成本与服务吞吐量QPS）下，对整个模型集群的特征进行优化。在该系统中，LLM智能体负责提出假设，确定性工具负责执行实验并验证假设。对于每个模型，LLM从组合式候选空间中生成并初筛交叉特征，随后采用多种重要性方法对所有特征进行排序。特征融合将上述多个排序混合为单一选择，对于多任务模型则利用跨任务的帕累托前沿。接着，LLM研究员智能体在资源上限约束下通过10至25次异步试验对特征选择进行调优，并由修剪步骤确保管线成本保持在预算之内。在生产模型上，该系统……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出了一个端到端的LLM智能体系统，在跨模型共享与逐模型设定的资源约束下，为大规模排序模型集群自动化地完成假设生成、交叉特征生成与筛选、多方法重要性排序融合以及异步试验调优，实现成本感知的跨模型特征优化。
en_tdlr: This paper presents an end-to-end LLM agentic system that optimizes feature selection across a fleet of large-scale ranking models under shared and per-model resource constraints, combining LLM hypothesis generation, cross-feature shortlisting, multi-method importance ranking with Pareto-front blending, and asynchronous trial-based tuning verified by deterministic tools.
